_comment: Accepted npm audit advisories (R-SECURITY-004). Gate: scripts/security/audit-gate.mjs. Production high/critical can never be accepted here. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry date; an expired entry fails the gate and must be re-reviewed.

advisories.reason: Missing bounds check only in v3/v5/v6 when a caller passes its own output buffer. exceljs calls uuid.v4() without a buffer (lib/xlsx/xform/sheet/cf-ext/cf-rule-ext-xform.js); no user input reaches it. Fix requires exceljs 3.x→ breaking downgrade offered by npm; waiting for an exceljs release on uuid >= 11.1.1.

Needs a pre-existing prototype pollution to bypass `trust`. The vulnerable copy is only imported by micromark-extension-math's HTML compiler, which the app never uses (remark-math is used for parsing to mdast; rendering uses katex 0.19 with trust off). Direct katex dependencies are 0.19.0 (fixed).

Unauthenticated mock registration over the vitest browser-mode/UI server, which this project never starts (node environment only, no --ui, no browser mode). Dev-only, not shipped. The critical tinypool advisories (GHSA-5gmw-xhrv-c9v3, GHSA-85c8-ppgw-ccpr) were fixed by the upgrade 3.2.7 → 4.1.11 (23.10.2026); 4.1.12 (fix for this one) was released 15.10.2026 and is held back until it is two weeks old.

Windows-only backslash traversal in the redirect allowlist of the browser-mode mock server; tests run on Linux in node mode, the server is never started. Dev-only, not shipped. Fixed in vitest 4.1.12 (upgrade after the two-week hold).
